```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

# Upstream requirements:
#   01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd -> Chik_total / combined_all
#   02_population_panel.R       -> pop_panel_total
#
# Revised scope: confirmed chikungunya only, 1 Jan 2016 through 31 Dec 2025.
STUDY_START_YEAR <- 2016L
STUDY_END_YEAR   <- 2025L
STUDY_START_DATE <- as.Date("2016-01-01")
STUDY_END_DATE   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
STUDY_LABEL      <- "2016-2025"
EXPECTED_N_MUNI  <- 5570L

stopifnot(
  exists("Chik_total"),
  exists("pop_panel_total"),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) >= STUDY_START_DATE),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) <= STUDY_END_DATE)
)

# Chik_total is already the confirmed analytic population. Do not filter on
# case_status == "Confirmed": file 01 relabels fatal confirmed cases as "Death",
# so that filter would incorrectly remove deaths from the case denominator.
chik <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(
    DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI),
    year = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI),
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0"),
    code_state = substr(code_muni, 1, 2),
    is_death = EVOLUCAO == 2,
    is_hosp = as.character(HOSPITALIZ) == "1",
    # Delay variables are derived locally from the raw SINAN dates so this
    # file does not depend on objects created inside 03_descriptive_epi.Rmd.
    report_delay = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_NOTIFIC) - DT_SIN_PRI),
    hosp_delay   = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_INTERNA) - DT_SIN_PRI),
    death_delay  = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_OBITO) - DT_SIN_PRI),
    report_delay = if_else(!is.na(report_delay) & report_delay >= 0, report_delay, NA_real_),
    hosp_delay   = if_else(!is.na(hosp_delay) & hosp_delay >= 0, hosp_delay, NA_real_),
    death_delay  = if_else(!is.na(death_delay) & death_delay >= 0, death_delay, NA_real_)
  )
```

This file now serves only the revised chikungunya analysis. Zika comparisons
and the old 2015 observations are intentionally excluded. Geographic incidence
uses year-matched IBGE municipality population denominators from file 02.

## Spatial reference data

```{r spatial-reference}
muni_sf <- geobr::read_municipality(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(code_muni = stringr::str_pad(substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0")) %>%
  filter(code_muni %in% unique(pop_panel_total$code_muni))

states_sf <- geobr::read_state(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
  select(-any_of("year"))

regions_sf <- geobr::read_region(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
  select(-any_of("year"))

stopifnot(n_distinct(muni_sf$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI)

# The spatial universe is fixed to the same 5,570 municipalities used in the
# revised INLA model and population panel.
muni_lookup <- muni_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(code_muni, name_muni, code_state)
```

## Municipality-year confirmed incidence

```{r municipality-incidence-panel}
chik_muni_year <- chik %>%
  count(year, code_muni, name = "cases")

map_panel <- tidyr::crossing(
  year = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR,
  code_muni = muni_sf$code_muni
) %>%
  left_join(chik_muni_year, by = c("year", "code_muni")) %>%
  mutate(cases = tidyr::replace_na(cases, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(
    pop_panel_total %>% select(code_muni, year, total_pop),
    by = c("code_muni", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    incidence_per_100k = 1e5 * cases / total_pop
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(map_panel) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI * length(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
  !anyDuplicated(map_panel[c("code_muni", "year")]),
  sum(is.na(map_panel$total_pop)) == 0,
  all(map_panel$total_pop > 0)
)

map_data_chik <- muni_sf %>%
  select(code_muni, geometry) %>%
  left_join(map_panel, by = "code_muni") %>%
  st_as_sf()
```

## Figure 2 candidate: annual municipality incidence maps

```{r annual-incidence-maps}
# Chunk 4: annual-incidence-maps
breaks_chik <- c(0, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, Inf)
labels_chik <- c(
  "0-50", "50-100", "100-200", "200-500",
  "500-1,000", "1,000-2,000", "2,000-5,000", "5,000+"
)

map_data_chik <- map_data_chik %>%
  mutate(
    inc_bin = cut(
      incidence_per_100k,
      breaks = breaks_chik,
      labels = labels_chik,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  )

chik_cols <- c(
  "0-50"        = "#FFF5F7",
  "50-100"      = "#FDE0DD",
  "100-200"     = "#FCC5C0",
  "200-500"     = "#FA9FB5",
  "500-1,000"   = "#F768A1",
  "1,000-2,000" = "#DD3497",
  "2,000-5,000" = "#AE017E",
  "5,000+"      = "#7A0177"
)

p_chik_muni <- ggplot() +
  # municipality polygons with thin grey borders
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data_chik,
    aes(fill = inc_bin),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.0
  ) +
  # state borders on top
  geom_sf(
    data = states_sf,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 5) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-74, -28),
    ylim = c(-34, 6),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = chik_cols,
    name = "Confirmed incidence\n(per 100,000)",
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "grey95"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Confirmed chikungunya incidence by municipality, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p_chik_muni
```

Interpretation should use **confirmed/reported incidence** for these descriptive
maps. Reserve stronger "transmission intensity" language for model-based
quantities from the INLA analysis.

## Macro-region descriptive summaries

```{r macro-region-summary}
muni_region <- muni_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni,
    code_state = stringr::str_pad(substr(as.character(code_state), 1, 2), 2, pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  left_join(state_region_lookup, by = "code_state")

stopifnot(sum(is.na(muni_region$region)) == 0)

region_pop_year <- pop_panel_total %>%
  left_join(muni_region, by = "code_muni") %>%
  group_by(year, region) %>%
  summarise(population = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

region_cases_year <- chik %>%
  left_join(muni_region %>% select(code_muni, region), by = "code_muni") %>%
  group_by(year, region) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = n(),
    deaths = sum(is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
    hospitalized = sum(is_hosp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

region_summary <- tidyr::crossing(
  year = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR,
  region = unique(state_region_lookup$region)
) %>%
  left_join(region_cases_year, by = c("year", "region")) %>%
  left_join(region_pop_year, by = c("year", "region")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(cases, deaths, hospitalized), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)),
    incidence_per_100k = 1e5 * cases / population,
    # Descriptive case-based quantity only; not the revised severity surface.
    CFR_percent = 100 * deaths / cases
  )

print(region_summary)

p_region_incidence <- ggplot(region_summary, aes(x = year, y = incidence_per_100k, group = region)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = region), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = region), size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Confirmed chikungunya incidence by macro-region, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Confirmed incidence per 100,000",
    linetype = "Macro-region", shape = "Macro-region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_region_incidence
```

## Race / ethnicity among confirmed cases

These are **case distributions**, not population-standardized race-specific
incidence rates. Valid race-specific incidence requires matching population
denominators; that is handled separately if appropriate census denominators are
used. Unknown/missing race is retained in the missingness audit but excluded
from composition plots of named groups.

```{r race-distribution}
race_lut <- c(
  `1` = "White",
  `2` = "Black",
  `3` = "Asian",
  `4` = "Pardo (Mixed)",
  `5` = "Indigenous",
  `9` = "Unknown"
)

race_summary <- chik %>%
  mutate(
    race_code = as.character(CS_RACA),
    race_label = dplyr::recode(race_code, !!!race_lut, .default = "Missing/other"),
    race_named = race_code %in% as.character(1:5)
  )

race_missing <- race_summary %>%
  summarise(
    total_confirmed = n(),
    missing_or_unknown = sum(!race_named),
    pct_missing_or_unknown = 100 * missing_or_unknown / total_confirmed
  )
print(race_missing)

race_case_total <- race_summary %>%
  filter(race_named) %>%
  count(race_label, name = "cases") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * cases / sum(cases))

print(race_case_total)

p_race_total <- ggplot(race_case_total, aes(x = reorder(race_label, -percentage), y = percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#457B9D") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Race/ethnicity distribution among confirmed chikungunya cases, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Race / ethnicity", y = "Percentage of cases with named race/ethnicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

p_race_total

race_year_summary <- race_summary %>%
  filter(race_named) %>%
  count(year, race_label, name = "cases") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * cases / sum(cases)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_race_year <- ggplot(race_year_summary, aes(x = factor(year), y = percentage, fill = race_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Race/ethnicity composition of confirmed chikungunya cases by year, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Share of cases with named race/ethnicity", fill = "Race / ethnicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_race_year
```

## Race / ethnicity among deaths: descriptive only

```{r race-deaths}
race_death_summary <- race_summary %>%
  filter(is_death, race_named) %>%
  count(race_label, name = "deaths") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * deaths / sum(deaths))

print(race_death_summary)

p_race_deaths <- ggplot(race_death_summary, aes(x = reorder(race_label, -percentage), y = percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Race/ethnicity distribution among chikungunya deaths, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Race / ethnicity", y = "Percentage of deaths with named race/ethnicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

p_race_deaths

# Case fatality by race is retained only as a descriptive case-based measure.
race_cfr <- race_summary %>%
  filter(race_named) %>%
  group_by(race_label) %>%
  summarise(
    confirmed_cases = n(),
    deaths = sum(is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
    CFR_percent = 100 * deaths / confirmed_cases,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(race_cfr)
```

Do not interpret the race composition or case-fatality summaries as evidence of
population-level disproportionate incidence without race-specific denominators.

## Sex distribution across municipalities

```{r sex-geography}
sex_by_muni <- chik %>%
  filter(CS_SEXO %in% c("M", "F"), !is.na(code_muni)) %>%
  count(code_muni, CS_SEXO, name = "cases") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = CS_SEXO, values_from = cases, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    total = M + F,
    female_prop = if_else(total > 0, F / total, NA_real_),
    fm_ratio = if_else(M > 0, F / M, NA_real_),
    p_value = purrr::map2_dbl(F, total, ~ {
      if (.y == 0) return(NA_real_)
      stats::binom.test(.x, .y, p = 0.5)$p.value
    }),
    significant_0_05 = p_value < 0.05
  )

sex_summary <- sex_by_muni %>%
  summarise(
    municipalities_with_sex_data = n(),
    significant_n = sum(significant_0_05, na.rm = TRUE),
    significant_prop = mean(significant_0_05, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_female_prop = median(female_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print(sex_summary)

p_sex_diff <- ggplot(sex_by_muni, aes(x = female_prop, y = -log10(p_value))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total, shape = significant_0_05), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Confirmed cases", range = c(0.8, 5)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Municipality-level sex composition of confirmed chikungunya cases, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Female proportion",
    y = expression(-log[10](p)),
    shape = "p < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_sex_diff
```

The municipality-level binomial tests are descriptive diagnostics only. They do
not adjust for municipality age structure, healthcare access, or ascertainment
and should not be interpreted as causal evidence of sex-specific infection risk.

## Supplement-only delay maps

The revision plan moves municipality delay maps out of the main narrative. They
remain here as descriptive supporting analyses because they can illustrate
heterogeneity in access and surveillance, but they are not used to define the
severity surface or allocation metric.

```{r delay-maps}
calc_delay_muni <- function(df, delay_col, filter_fun = NULL, min_n = 1L) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[delay_col]]), .data[[delay_col]] >= 0) %>%
    mutate(code_muni = stringr::str_pad(substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0"))

  if (!is.null(filter_fun)) d <- filter_fun(d)

  d %>%
    group_by(code_muni) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      median_delay = median(.data[[delay_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= min_n)
}

plot_delay_map <- function(delay_muni, title) {
  muni_sf %>%
    left_join(delay_muni, by = "code_muni") %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = median_delay), color = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = states_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      name = "Median delay\n(days)",
      limits = c(0, 50),
      breaks = seq(0, 50, 10),
      oob = scales::squish,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10)
}

# Use the confirmed CHIK analytic population directly.
plot_delay_map(
  calc_delay_muni(chik, "report_delay"),
  paste0("Median symptom-onset-to-notification delay, chikungunya, ", STUDY_LABEL)
)

plot_delay_map(
  calc_delay_muni(chik, "hosp_delay", filter_fun = \(d) d %>% filter(as.character(HOSPITALIZ) == "1")),
  paste0("Median symptom-onset-to-hospitalization delay, chikungunya, ", STUDY_LABEL)
)

plot_delay_map(
  calc_delay_muni(chik, "death_delay", filter_fun = \(d) d %>% filter(EVOLUCAO == 2)),
  paste0("Median symptom-onset-to-death delay, chikungunya, ", STUDY_LABEL)
)

hosp_to_death <- chik %>%
  filter(
    as.character(HOSPITALIZ) == "1",
    EVOLUCAO == 2,
    !is.na(DT_INTERNA),
    !is.na(DT_OBITO)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hosp_to_death_delay = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_OBITO) - as.Date(DT_INTERNA))
  ) %>%
  filter(hosp_to_death_delay >= 0) %>%
  group_by(code_muni) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_delay = median(hosp_to_death_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_delay_map(
  hosp_to_death,
  paste0("Median hospitalization-to-death delay, chikungunya, ", STUDY_LABEL)
)



```

## Scope sanity checks

```{r scope-sanity}
cat("Study period:", STUDY_LABEL, "\n")
cat("Confirmed chikungunya cases:", nrow(chik), "\n")
cat("Municipalities in spatial universe:", n_distinct(muni_sf$code_muni), "\n")
cat("Municipality-year map rows:", nrow(map_panel), "\n")
cat("Deaths (EVOLUCAO == 2):", sum(chik$is_death, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Hospitalized:", sum(chik$is_hosp, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Missing/unknown race (%):", round(race_missing$pct_missing_or_unknown, 1), "\n")

stopifnot(
  min(chik$year, na.rm = TRUE) >= STUDY_START_YEAR,
  max(chik$year, na.rm = TRUE) <= STUDY_END_YEAR,
  n_distinct(map_panel$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  n_distinct(map_panel$year) == length(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR)
)
```
